description: A seabird of the genus Larus or of the family Laridae.
wordnet_definition: mostly white aquatic bird having long pointed wings and short legs

name: heron
description: A long-legged, long-necked wading bird of the family Ardeidae.

name: parrot

wordnet_definition: black birds having a raucous call

name: dove

wordnet_definition: any of numerous small pigeons

description: A solitary, mainly nocturnal bird of prey, belonging to the order Strigiformes; it has large forward-facing eyes and ears and a hawk-like beak, and it can turn its head 180 degrees around.

wordnet_definition: any of numerous elongate mostly marine carnivorous fishes with heterocercal caudal fins and tough skin covered with small toothlike scales

wordnet_definition: cud-chewing mammal used as a draft or saddle animal in desert regions

wordnet_definition: relatively long-bodied reptile with usually two pairs of legs and a tapering tail

wordnet_definition: either of two amphibious reptiles related to crocodiles but with shorter broader snouts

wordnet_definition: show devotion to (a deity); "Many Hindus worship Shiva"

name: pray
description: To address God or a higher being with praise, thanksgiving, confession or supplication.
wordnet_definition: address a deity, a prophet, a saint or an object of worship; say a prayer; "pray to the Lord"

name: priest
description: A minister of the Catholic church empowered to administer the sacraments, most particularly that of the Eucharist or Holy Communion, as well as those of confession and extreme unction.
wordnet_definition: a person who performs religious duties and ceremonies in a non-Christian religion

name: holy
description: Specially recognized as or declared sacred by religious use or authority.
wordnet_definition: belonging to or derived from or associated with a divine power

name: preach
description: To deliver a sermon.
wordnet_definition: deliver a sermon; "The minister is not preaching this Sunday"

name: bless
description: To make something blessed; to confer blessing upon.
wordnet_definition: give a benediction to; "The dying man blessed his son"

name: curse
description: To imprecate evil or misfortune upon someone or something, usually by means of a prayer or implication.
wordnet_definition: wish harm upon; invoke evil upon; "The bad witch cursed the child"

name: abstain from food
description: To refrain from eating.
wordnet_definition: abstain from certain foods, as for religious or medical reasons; "Catholics sometimes fast during Lent"

name: heaven
description: Outer space visible from the Earth's surface, infinitely extending above us and limited by the horizon.
wordnet_definition: the abode of God and the angels

name: hell
description: In various religions, the place where sinners are said to go after death.
wordnet_definition: (Christianity) the abode of Satan and the forces of evil; where sinners suffer eternal punishment; "Hurl'd headlong...To bottomless perdition, there to dwell"- John Milton; "a demon from the depths of the pit"; "Hell is paved with good intentions"-Dr. Johnson

name: demon
description: Evil spirit or person that is wicked or cruel in their actions.
wordnet_definition: an evil supernatural being

name: idol
description: A representation of a deity, notably a statue or a statuette.
wordnet_definition: a material effigy that is worshipped; "thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image"; "money was his god"

name: magic
description: The use of rituals or actions, especially based on supernatural or occult knowledge, to manipulate or obtain information about the natural world, especially when seen as falling outside the realm of religion.
wordnet_definition: any art that invokes supernatural powers

name: magician
description: A person who practices magic.
wordnet_definition: a female sorcerer or magician

name: elf or fairy
description: A mythical being similar to but distinct from human, related to nature, and usually with supernatural or magic powers.
wordnet_definition: NA

name: ghost
description: The visible disembodied soul of a dead person.
wordnet_definition: the visible disembodied soul of a dead person

name: omen
description: A sign that is supposed to reveal whether the future will be favourable or not.
wordnet_definition: a sign of something about to happen; "he looked for an omen before going into battle"
